children: U.S. President Donald Trump pressed his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelenskiy in a call on Sunday to halt Kyiv's strikes on Russian refineries over concerns that the attacks are exacerbating a global diesel shortage and pushing up prices, the Financial Times reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the call.
